newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Morgan cuts AT&T estimate.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Morgan cuts AT&T estimate.

text.p: -- J.P. Morgan analyst Simon Flannery said he cut his 1997 earnings estimate on AT&T Corp to $3.40 per share from $3.60.
-- "Clearly 1997 is going to be a challenging year with significant spending to enter new markets and preparation for regional Bell entry into long distance," he said.
-- He noted that AT&T in 1997 would also incur 12 cents a share in costs for increased provisioning for bad debts and uncollectibles.
-- The analyst maintained his "market perform" rating on the stock.
